releaseNotes:
Includes all updates from v1.17.46 to v1.17.55.

🌟 What’s new

• Added “Alternate with +1 ticket” in Default Auto Clicker mode for Ticketek and Ticketmaster: 2 → 3 → 2 → 3 after unsuccessful attempts. OFF by default; only tries quantities the page allows.
• Added Voice, eight new sound packs and custom MP3/WAV uploads. Preview sounds or silence individual alerts.
• Keep Ticketek event, seat and price details visible through login and checkout, with the detected account name and email.
• Added Tek settings to decline the optional refundable-ticket add-on and copy your account name for pasting into Name on card. Both options can be turned off.
• Added minimum quantity of 1 in Ticketek Monitoring. After reducing the quantity, retries can alternate between 2 and 1 until refresh.

🛠️ Improvements and fixes

• Fixed Chrome alerts playing the wrong sound instead of your selected Voice, Custom or Silent option.
• Ticketmaster review-ticket warnings now default to 30 seconds remaining. Choose another time or select “Don’t warn.”
• Control recovery is ON by default for new monitoring setups. Your saved choices stay unchanged.
• Made settings easier to navigate and checkout account details easier to read.

Tickets on hold are not purchased yet. Complete checkout before the timer expires. Extension updates still require manual installation.
